<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Generate a slot plan"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/slot-plans"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Computes a new `Draft` plan for a site from the local demand, product and
layout copies and stores it. `siteId` defaults to the configured default
site; `lookbackDays` (1 to 365, default 28) sets the demand window, which
ends now and starts `lookbackDays` earlier. The plan lists its
assignments, the moves against the site's current Approved plan and the
SKUs it could not place, each with a reason. Requires an
`Idempotency-Key`; replaying the same key and body returns the original
plan.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":false,"description":"Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a\nretried request safe. Required whenever the service runs with Postgres,\nthat is in every deployment, and answered with 400\n`idempotency-key-required` when absent; a replay with the same key and\nthe same body returns the original response, while the same key with a\ndifferent body is 422 `idempotency-key-reused`. The in-memory development\nmode (no `DATABASE_URL`) does not enforce it, which is why the header is\nnot marked `required` here.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
